title: Axigen Mail Server 10.3.3.67 through 10.3.3.x, 10.4.42 through 10.4.x, 10.5.29 through 10.5.x, 10.6.x before 10.6.41,…
description: Axigen Mail Server versions 10.3.3.67 through 10.3.3.x, 10.4.42 through 10.4.x, 10.5.29 through 10.5.x, 10.6.x before 10.6.41, and 10.7.x before 10.7.3 contain an unauthenticated denial of service vulnerability. This flaw is due to uncontrolled recursion in the validation of query parameters and cookie values in the WebAdmin and WebMail services. An attacker can send a specially crafted HTTP request with a large query parameter or cookie value to exhaust the worker thread stack and crash the server, disrupting mail and web services.
